Release v0.3: the whole app at https://ticker.allomos.com, on a computer and on a phone.

1. Sign in with your own email address (the email comes from no-reply@ticker.allomos.com).
2. Make two or three lists; rename one, delete one.
3. Search by name and by ticker (apple, NVDA, vanguard, bitcoin, yen) and add tickers to your
   lists from the search results and from their pages.
4. Home: each list shows the latest price, the day's change and the price's time; remove one with ×.
5. Open a ticker: chart ranges 1D to MAX, key figures.
6. Sign out and in again, or open the site on your phone: your lists are still there.
